subject.title: iOS: keychain save fails on fresh install (cal save failed / disconnected because it could not securely save)

question: Should the iOS owner require signed-device OSStatus and entitlement evidence before authorizing a credential-storage code change for this blocker?
rationale: The failure is urgent, but the current Boolean-only Keychain result does not identify which security contract is failing; choosing a storage or entitlement change without that evidence could weaken the credential boundary or repair the wrong layer.

options.title: Capture diagnostics first
options.body: Use a signed diagnostic build to record sanitized OSStatus, protected-data state, access group, and effective entitlements before selecting the narrow fix.

options.title: Approve a speculative storage change
options.body: Change the Keychain query or accessibility behavior immediately, accepting that the root cause and security consequences are not yet established.

recommendation.title: Capture diagnostics first
recommendation.body: Use a signed diagnostic build to record sanitized OSStatus, protected-data state, access group, and effective entitlements before selecting the narrow fix.

likelyOwner.reason: The issue timeline directly routes this native iOS failure to `ngutman`, the strongest available signal for deciding the required signed-device proof.
